name: research-kickoff-brief
description: Writes the one-pager that aligns everyone before research starts, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run research-kickoff-brief", "write the research plan", "align the team on the research", "what's our research approach", or methods and guides exist but nobody has agreed on paper who is doing what by when. Use it even for "can you summarize our research setup".
